title: merge.review_body refuses a value outside its tables, so a bad review record cannot be built
why: Lane notes-fix-large-1 (session_013NEJL4DPEKRiC91yHkQV7m), 11:49 CST Nov 8: it posted a round-1 FAIL record on #2138 with "Net value: n/a". parse_review rejects it (REVIEW_NETS is "not owed", "zero", "positive", "negative"), but merge.review_body built the body without complaint, and the lane did not assert parse_review's result. Corrected to "not owed" (comment 6724494135). Fix: review_body refuses a net, kind or guard value outside its tables, or checks its own output with parse_review and raises.
